description: This file defines the Appointment class used within a calendar module of a CRM system, specifically vtiger CRM. It includes methods to read, process, and represent appointment data, including handling recurring events and user privileges.

classes.name: Appointment
classes.description: Represents a calendar appointment with functionality to read from database, interpret data, and handle recurring events within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: Appointment
methods.description: Constructor initializing participant arrays and description.

methods.name: readAppointment
methods.description: Fetches appointments for a user within a date range, considering sharing and recurring events.

methods.name: readResult
methods.description: Populates the appointment object fields based on a database result array.
